name: Mariner's Compass
text: [action] Exhaust Mariner's Compass: Investigate. If you succeed and have no resources in your resource pool, discover 1 additional clue at your location. [fast] During an investigation using Mariner's Compass, spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test. (Limit three times per investigation.)
text_cn: [action]消耗水手的罗盘：调查。如果你成功且你的资源池里没有资源，发现你所在地点的额外1个线索。 [fast]在使用水手的罗盘调查中，花费1资源：这次技能检定你+1[intellect]。(每次调查限制3次。)
